name: metis
description: Métis skills for Quality Engineering against a behaviour knowledge graph: knowledge-capture (turn a stated requirement into atomic acceptance criteria, then report what the model already has, what contradicts it, and what is new), model-build (recover a model from a code property graph and take it to the approval gate), review-assist (walk a reviewer through G1 to a recorded decision), behavior-modeling (determinism, guard completeness, reachability and observability), and intake-processor (extract a real source into one Unified Intake Format document). Every skill proposes; nothing approves.
